messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — vendor just pushed ETA for 120 H100s to June 12, staging dock window June 14–16. Might conflict with EU wave.

devon_ops: can you drop the AWB/PO? I'll check dock availability.

maria_g: PO# 45091, AWB EY123456789. Vendor email attached in thread (sent to anna_procure).

anna_procure: got it. We're pushing vendor for partial ship earlier. Asked for 40 units split into air vs sea, they're quoting +$18k for air expedite.

leo_infra: If we take 40 air, how does that impact our Dedicated capacity plans? We have 30 tasks queued in fra-edge cluster.

devon_ops: 40 air reduces sea by 40; staging dock can handle 40 on June 14 but needs 48h notice for manifests.

kai_logistics: also watch customs HS code — vendor used H1000 instead of H1001, might trigger extra duties and delay.

maria_g: vendor acknowledged HS mismatch, offered to reissue docs but will add a $220 reprocessing fee and possible customs brokerage hold.

anna_procure: can we push the vendor to eat the fee? They committed to correct docs in contract language.

maria_g: they've offered 50% credit on fee, will absorb expedite cost only if we commit to full batch. They want a 2-week payment term instead of 30.

leo_infra: Would prefer preserve cash. If vendor insists, we can accept partial air for the 40 but require vendor credit on customs fee.

devon_ops: RMA note — they flagged 3 DOA H100s in previous shipment; vendor wants to roll those into new shipment as "warranty swap" to avoid separate AWB. That triggers depot staging.

kai_logistics: we need serials and RMAs documented. rma_bot: New RMA created #RMA-9821 for serials S1234,S1235,S2389. ETA inbound Jun14.

maria_g: can ops confirm depot capacity for warranty swap and temp pool handling?

devon_ops: yes, depot approved space for up to 12 swaps on Jun14. Need inbound manifest by EOD Jun12.

anna_procure: asking vendor for updated invoice reflecting credit and new payment term. I'll escalate if no response in 24h.

leo_infra: FYI — if customs hold happens, we need failover routing to NL or use our Dedicated buffer in ie-eu. Cost tradeoff: ~€4k extra.

maria_g: okay, action items: 1) anna escalate credit/payment 2) devon push manifests/serials to rma_bot 3) kai track customs HS update with vendor. I'll post updates here.

kai_logistics: noted. pinging @rma_bot for manifest template.

rma_bot: manifest template: ```AWB,PO,Serial,SKU,RMANote``` — upload to https://redwood.s3/shipments/45091

devon_ops: uploaded manifest v1. link: https://redwood.s3/45091/manifest_v1.csv

maria_g: thanks — locking staging slot on June14 pending vendor docs. :thumbsup:
